notes.title: Surprise Release of Episode 1 during Wholesome Direct 2025!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube="qvvnrG5QMc4;full"][/previewyoutube]
Hey Guardians! 🌸



We're thrilled to announce that Episode 1 of «The Guardian of Nature» just had its surprise release as part of Wholesome Direct 2025! 



We are beyond excited to finally share the first episode with all of you!

Thank you all so much for your support and feedback, and for encouraging us on our journey! 💚

We're releasing episodically during Early Access because we would love to hear your feedback along the way! Episode 1 is completed and all of the features listed under "About this game" have been fully implemented. Also, by purchasing Episode 1 now, you will receive all future updates and episodes for free.



We hope you will love diving into the world of «The Guardian of Nature».



Take care 🌿

notes.title: Major Demo Update & Kickstarter Launching Soon! (Please spread the word 🙏)
notes.notes:
Hey Guardians! 🌸

While this update has been a long time coming, we have been busy like bees! 😇🐝 We have some exciting news to share with you!

First of all: Thank you so much for all of your incredibly helpful feedback when playing the «The Guardian of Nature» demo 🙏. We are so grateful that thousands of people have played the demo and that so many of you took the time to write down your thoughts, your play experience, what you liked and how we could improve the game. And we did! Many of you told us that there were these key things that you would like to see in the game:

✅ ✨ More story and background about The Guardians of Nature and the mission of Henry.
✅ 🧩 Hint system for puzzles.
✅ 🗺️ An in-game navigation to explore and visit all the environments.
✅ 🎛️ Quality of life improvements like more settings for sound and music.
✅ 🌸 More music tracks to change between environments.

Introducing: The Book of Nature! 📔

Many of the above points have been addressed by the creation of The Book of Nature, which tells the story of «The Guardian of Nature» through a beautiful fairytale-inspired narrative. Throughout the game, you will regularly find and collect "Nature Cards", which unlock new pages in the book 📔. They tell you more about the ancient wisdom of the Guardians of Nature, the interconnectedness of nature, and give you hints on how to continue your journey.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209094/c6ffcdd27045edb92c9b01799b647c027dd71a5b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209094/adce3017204146c9f1183baf395072b3bbd52be8.png

Once you have accessed locations, they become accessible in The Book of Nature 📔. A map helps you to navigate and understand how environments are connected 🗺️.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209094/10d3cb40c11d1df9f5011353c7f2cdb57567161b.png

In addition: We will be releasing a new and updated demo of the game very soon, alongside a Kickstarter campaign that we are currently preparing. 

It would mean the world to us if you would follow the Kickstarter campaign to be notified when it launches and tell your friends about it. Have a look here:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/inlusio/the-guardian-of-nature-game/


While early funding and our own resources will allow us to bring «The Guardian of Nature» to market, this Kickstarter campaign will allow us to realise the full vision of the game and share an exciting moment in the game’s journey together with you as a community!

Thank you for everything and take good care  🌱
Your fellow Guardians

notes.title: Demo update & «The Guardian of Nature» at Cozy Quest 2024!
notes.notes:
Hey Guardians! 🌻

We are really excited to be a part of the upcoming Cozy Quest Festival on Steam from the 14th to the 18th of November 2024.

Thank you so much for all the wonderful feedback we have received since we released the demo of «The Guardian of Nature» during the Tiny Teams Festival and the Wholesome Games Celebration back in August. We have been going through all your input and have updated the demo with bug fixes and Steam Deck compatibility (we are really excited about the last one and love to play and test the game anywhere!).

Thank you so much Secret Mode for organizing the Cozy Quest Festival! We look forward to seeing all the other wonderful games. Be sure to check out Cozy Quest here:

Cozy Quest Steam Festival 2024

Please check out the demo and it would be wonderful if you sent us feedback via the form in the demo! 💚

Take care 🌱
